endorsements.name: David Bryan
endorsements.label: Home Invasion v2.0 - Attacking Network-Controlled Hardware
endorsements.description: A growing trend in electronics is to have them integrate with your home network in order to provide potentially useful features like automatic updates or to extend the usefulness of existing technologies such as door locks you can open and close from anywhere in the world. What this means for us as security professionals or even just as people living in a world of network-connected devices is that being compromised poses greater risk than before.
